dialogues.speaker: Message Board
dialogues.text: "The Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament has begun! Hundreds of contestants are capturing and putting together their team of formidable Fungi!"

dialogues.speaker: Message Board
dialogues.text: "Once the preparation phase ends, the staff will confirm whether the contestants have collected four Fungi as required, and will randomly put together the preliminary round schedule."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... There are so many clauses here! There's even a... disclaimer?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This is giving Paimon a headache... Paimon doesn't want to read any of this. Let's just skip it! The prize money is what's most important anyway...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahem! What Paimon meant was, if there's anything about the Fungi. Like whether the Fungi can be shown in public or not... and stuff...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, let's see if we can find it!

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Competition Rewards - Top 8: Sizable amount of Mora, limited-edition Nilotpala Cup Season 1 Honorary Title, and the permission to keep the ace Fungus..."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A sizable amount of Mora? Wait... They didn't include the actual amount...? And what's this about the permission to keep your Ace Fungus? Do they mean we can take one home to keep as a pet?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's keep reading...

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Fungi Activity Rules - Rule #3: Fungi that are registered and controlled by a Wisdom Orb are allowed to move around freely in areas proximate to the arena. Beast tamers, please pay extra attention to the activity borders."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Activity areas only include areas around the arena and the main roads of Port Ormos. Please do not bring your Fungi to the following public areas: Wikala Funduq, shops, and restaurants."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Currently, this competition is unknown to some members of the population. Panic or chaos may occur if Fungi were to appear in front of individuals who are unaware of the competition. It is recommended that everyone manage their Fungi accordingly."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "The Corps of Thirty will referee the competitors to ensure that all rules are followed. Competitors who violate the rules will be disqualified immediately. If the violation is considered a gross offense, further responsibilities may be pursued and punishment from the Akademiya may occur."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... the rules are really strict! They're really serious about this. We should be careful as well!

choices.text: Did you just speak your real thoughts out loud?

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "After the results of the preliminary rounds are finalized, audience members can leave a comment on this competition billboard to show their support for the competitors or to share their thoughts about Fungi!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "All comments will be screened and evaluated by staff before they are posted. Please refrain from leaving comments that are over-the-top and be nice!"

dialogues.speaker: Message Board
dialogues.text: "The Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament preliminary round results are in. Thirty-two magnificent contenders have made it through and will be showcasing a visual feast of fierce competition to you all..."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Competition Rewards - Top 8: Sizable amount of Mora, limited-edition Nilotpala Cup Season 1 Honorary Title, and the permission to keep the ace Fungus..."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Fungi Activity Rules - Rule #3: Fungi that are registered and controlled by a Wisdom Orb are allowed to move around freely in areas proximate to the arena. Beast tamers, please pay extra attention to the activity borders."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Activity areas only include areas around the arena and the main roads of Port Ormos. Please do not bring your Fungi to the following public areas: Wikala Funduq, shops, and restaurants."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Currently, this competition is unknown to some members of the population. Panic or chaos may occur if Fungi were to appear in front of individuals who are unaware of the competition. It is recommended that everyone manage their Fungi accordingly."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "The Corps of Thirty will referee the competitors to ensure that all rules are followed. Competitors who violate the rules will be disqualified immediately. If the violation is considered a gross offense, further responsibilities may be pursued and punishment from the Akademiya may occur."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems like the rules are pretty clear.

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Floating Fungi are the cutest! Whether they're Hydro, Anemo, or Dendro!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Every Floating Fungus has a big head and its body is soft. It moves around slowly, and sways back and forth as it does so."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Let's make a Floating Fungi Protection Association together!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Reminder from the staff: Competition Fungi are special, wild Fungi are dangerous!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Enjoy the competition responsibly. Please do not attempt to imitate anything you see!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Your family would be sad if you were injured by a monster!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Maybe the organizers should add some kind of balancing mechanism to make the competition more competitive."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "For example, attach a point system to each Fungus that enters battle. Each team has a limited number of points, and the stronger the Fungi, the higher the points."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "With that put in place, the competitors will need to take a strategic approach to what Fungi they include in their team. This also guarantees a more competitive atmosphere."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: You idiot! The audience won't be able to understand what's going on if the competition becomes too complicated!

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: Everyone's just here to have a good time. Nobody wants to count dumb points and guess strategies while watching the competition!

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: Besides, the skills of the stronger Fungi are awesome. If you restrict them from entering the arena, the competition might get stale really quickly!

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "The preliminary round is over. When will the competition film be available for purchase?"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "I'm having a hard time staying in my seat. There are so many competitors with really cool nicknames that sound like they have a strong team! Ordinary audiences won't be able to watch every single match. We need the film!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "It's okay even if it's a little pricey. After all, competitions like this are rare, and it's exciting to watch even the second or third time around!"

dialogues.speaker: Message Board
dialogues.text: "The Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament is moving along quickly. Sixteen powerful competitors will be going head-to-head in the next phase of the competition..."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Disclaimer - Clause Two: Confirmation of eligibility indicates that the contestant is aware of the possible negative effects that Wisdom Orb usage may have on the body..."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Disclaimer - Clause Seven: All rights of interpretation belong to the organizer and researcher, Mr. Kautilya. If a legal dispute shall arise, please refer to the appropriate channels for official procedures..."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (I don't think I looked at the detailed content of these rules before...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Haniyyah and Pyro-1, keep it up! You guys got this!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Your combat style is bold and a treat to watch."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "I wonder if Haniyyah is accepting apprentices? I want to learn how to beast tame from her and make friends with all sorts of Fungi!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Golden Comet and Silver Companion are so ridiculously strong! I wonder if they're Fungi veterans!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "With the two of them here, I would say that this season's champions are already decided!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "I hear that Silver Companion has an obsession with Mora. Maybe we should pool some together and ask Silver Companion if they can take it easy and throw the match!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "That way, ordinary people like us would have a shot at winning the competition!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Are you a competitor from their group!? It would be cheating if you tried to use Mora to bribe them!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "They'll let their skills do the talking! You should use the time you spent coming up with stupid ideas like this to train instead!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "I think it's still too early to say that they'll be the final winners. I'm pretty sure they'll have a hard time if they're matched against Fried Tofu With All the Frills."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wh—What's going on!? Is there a comment Paimon shouldn't see!?

choices.text: (Pretend not to have seen it and cover Paimon's eyes.)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "A foreign guest by the name of Aratani is collecting photos of the Fungi. They say that she has ways to produce Fungi picture cards that are extremely valuable collectibles!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "But Miss Aratani seems to be looking to make money off this. That's why she's dividing up the sales channel for the picture cards."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Anyone who's willing to purchase her cards, please leave a comment below! If you have any cute photos of the Fungi, make sure you send them to us as well!"

dialogues.speaker: Message Board
dialogues.text: "The Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament quarter-finals are approaching. Things are heating up! Audience members and competitors, please show us your excitement!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "To be honest, even though the competitions are exciting, the Fungi's abilities should really be applied in other areas as well. For example, they should be used to escort caravans or to guard the city."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "If that happens, a lot of the pressure will be taken off the Corps of Thirty, and merchants wouldn't need to spend so much money on hiring bodyguards."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Goods might even become cheaper when the cost decreases! After all, I'm sure the merchants factor the cost of hiring bodyguards into the sale price of the goods. We, the customers, are the ones that pay for it."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "So I think it's safe to say that it could be very beneficial for us ordinary people if this event were to become even more popular!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "I recommend banning the use of Stretchy Geo Fungi! The skills on that type of Fungus are way too strong!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Launching an entire team of Fungi in an instant is way too overpowered!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Haha, I can tell that you're an amateur from your comment! The strong abilities of Stretchy Geo Fungi come at a cost — the skill can't be used frequently in combat, and Stretchy Geo Fungi can easily be focused down!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "If you use proper team composition, you'll be able to limit the Stretchy Geo Fungi's combat capabilities!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Kautilya, when are you gonna pay me back the money you owe me!?"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Don't tell me you forgot about the 3,500 Mora you asked me for five years ago to pay for the medical supplies!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Don't you go ignoring a student who've run errands for you for years now that you're a big and successful researcher with a powerful sponsor!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Is this true? This is an accusation against someone important on the staff!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seems to be an official response to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Reminder from the Nilotpala Cup staff: This comment is not in violation and is within the parameters of the 'Friendly Comments' regulations. This comment will not be deleted."

dialogues.speaker: Message Board
dialogues.text: "The Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament semi-finals is just around the corner! The competitors are slowly revealing the aces up their sleeves, and are ready to put on an extravagant display of competition and excitement for their audience and fans..."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "That Whirling Pyro Fungus is so strong! The entire film was shaking when it used its explosion skill!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Maybe all the competitors should just use a Whirling Pyro Fungus in their battles."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "The competition has been going on for a little while. I'm just curious, how do each of the competitors train their Fungi?"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Everyone's Fungi started out the same, but they seem to be completely different in battle. It must be because of their training!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "I think that the organizers should allow the audience to look around the training facilities too. I want to get to know each contestant's style and how they spend each day with their Fungi."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Bro, don't be stupid! The training grounds are extremely dangerous! It's nothing like the arena!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Besides, the competitors will definitely show us their best during their matches. There's no need for us to know everything they do. That'll only make things more difficult for them."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Retired Senior Adventurer, Baron Bigfoot, used his savings and purchased the spectacular competition film and a film player!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "We will be organizing regular events to watch the competition at Baron Bigfoot's place. Anyone who's interested, please leave us a comment."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "He is not charging any fees and will provide food and beverages! However, he won't be able to manage it all on his own, so it'd be great if everyone could bring some too!"

dialogues.speaker: Message Board
dialogues.text: "The Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament finals are upon us! Haniyyah, the beast tamer veteran, is going up against the powerful Golden Comet and Silver Companion!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "The competition is too jam-packed. There are too many matches going on at the same time. I haven't even had the time to get to know the background of all the competitors, and we're already at the finals, ugh!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "If there are more competitions after this one, please don't schedule the matches so closely together! And maybe consider revival matches to give competitors who had a bad day a second chance!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Thank you for your support! The staff at Nilotpala Cup has received your suggestions."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "The first ever Nilotpala Cup hoped to deliver the joy of 'Beast Taming' and 'Fungus Battle' to everyone. Due to limited resources, we apologize and ask for your understanding for any inconvenience."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "The next season of the Nilotpala Cup is already in the works. We have plans to adjust the tempo of the matches and the rules of the competition. Please feel free to sign up and participate if you are interested."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "With all of your wisdom and input, we are confident that the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament will be an event that takes Sumeru by storm!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "It's finally the finals. I've been waiting for an evenly matched fight."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "To be honest, the matches prior to this one were a little boring. They were too friendly! There was no excitement... I'd rather see the competitors give it everything they've got. I want them to go for each other's throats! An exciting competition should be fierce and filled with rivalry!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "I completely disagree! This is a competitive event, not a brawl! The cute Fungi should be quickly tended to after being wounded in the match. And you're here talking about spilling blood!?"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "If it's excitement that you're looking for, you can go pick up one of the bounties posted by the Corps of Thirty and go fight the vicious Fungi in the wild!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Not only will that satisfy your needs, it'll also bring great joy to us!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Someone mentioned before that we can use tamed Fungi to help with security. I find that to be a great idea. It can even be applied to other areas as well!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "They can help with protecting cargo shipments, crop irrigation, or even mining. The possibilities are endless."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Obviously, it's all on the premise that the 'beast taming' techniques are steadily passed on to more people, and the cost of Wisdom Orbs is reduced."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Also, we'll have to monitor and solve any issues regarding the reliability of the Wisdom Orbs once its application is introduced on a large scale..."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Maybe the organizers should hire the competitors as instructors to teach the general public about the usage of the orbs... Hmm, that could be a great idea."

dialogues.speaker: Message Board
dialogues.text: "We'd like to thank all the competitors for their extravagant performances and the support of all of our audience! The first season of the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament has come to an end..."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Although there were a few hiccups at the end of the finals, they were all resolved by the champions Golden Comet and Silver Companion!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Due to technical difficulties, we are unsure as to when the next season of the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament will be hosted. However, we promise that we will resolve the issues as quickly as possible and bring back the competition that you all enjoy!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Meanwhile, please continue to show us your support!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Although I really hoped that the Nilotpala Cup would continue to be held, after finding out about the flaws of the Wisdom Orb, I fully stand behind Silver Companion's decision!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Health and safety is definitely the top priority. I hope that all the competitors are safe and continue to maintain their friendship with their Fungi companions. That way, they'll be able to return to the arena and bring us even more exciting competitions!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There are a number of comments stating people's understanding of Paimon's decision, a concern for the condition of the competitors, and their hopes of the competition being continued in the future.)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (Everyone seems to be happy with the fierce match and Paimon's victory speech. There are no negative comments...)
